Dear Sir(s)/Madam, 
Sub: Submission of Scrutinizer’s Report for e-voting through Postal Ballot 
In continuation to our earlier intimation bearing reference  no. LTIM/SE/STAT/2025-26/97 
dated February 11,  2026 whereby we  had submitted  the Postal Ballot  Notice seeking 
approval of  Members for Change of  Name of  the Company and consequent alteration of 
the Memorandum and Articles of Association. 
We hereby wish to inform you that basis the report issued by Scrutinizer today i.e. on March 
13, 2026 (as enclosed) , the aforementioned  resolution  has been duly passed with  requisite 
majority.  
The Scrutinizer’s report shall also be made available on the Company’s website at 
https://www.ltm.com/investors/notices and on the website of NSDL at 
www.evoting.nsdl.com . 
Basis approval of  shareholders,  we shall now make an application to the MCA seeking its 
approval to effectuate the change of name to LTM Limited  by issuing a fresh Certificate of 
Incorporation pursuant to change of name. 
This is for your information and record. 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
For LTIMindtree Limited
